narrative.intro: The ranking shows the fastest-growing federal contract markets for FY2027 to date. Total obligations were $14.4B. Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences grew 481.0% year over year, the largest increase on the list. Facilities Support Services rose 113.7% and Nonferrous Metal (except Aluminum) Smelting and Refining rose 73.2%. Computer Systems Design Services increased 67.6% and Security Guards and Patrol Services increased 66.6%. The list also includes Couriers and Express Delivery Services at 40.4%, Temporary Help Services at 31.3%, Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Biotechnology) at 15.3%, Computing Infrastructure Providers, Data Processing, Web Hosting, and Related Services at 13.1%, and Colleges, Universities, and Professional Schools at 9.5%. These figures reflect year-over-year changes for the same period and the current-year totals are partial because the dataset covers fiscal year to date activity.
